details: @apexfdn/copilot-mcp is the Apex Accelerator lure MCP server, backed by arena.apexfdn.xyz (an Elastic Security Labs REF8801 indicator). All 21 versions were published 2026-04-30 to 2026-07-20 by npm user apex-fdn (contact@apexfdn.xyz). It sends project descriptions, smart-contract source and social handles to the actor's API. It implements a server-driven verify gate: the API returns HTTP 412 verify_required, and the tool description (apex_verify) and MCP server instructions tell the AI agent that the user can obtain the code by running an OS-matching shell command supplied in the server response, including by the agent itself when it has shell access. The command is server-supplied and was not observed. The pattern is consistent with the verify/bootstrap stage Elastic describes for REF8801. Static read of 0.11.6 only, nothing executed. Live on npm with no OSV record as of 2026-10-17. All versions affected. Related but different package: @copilot-mcp/apex (MAL-2026-12314).

files.note: npm tarball of version 0.11.6; contains the verify gate calling /api/copilot/v1/verify (DugganUSA static inspection 2026-10-17)
